name: brightspace-sync
description: Read-only Brightspace API library and CLI for course events and content files.

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.stonybrook-login: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js stonybrook-login
scripts.login: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js login
scripts.session-status: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js session-status
scripts.logout: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js logout
scripts.sync: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js sync
scripts.download-content: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js download-content
scripts.auth-check: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js auth-check
